messages:
amy: Quick idea 1: build a lightweight 'soft-admit' shim in the ingress proxy. Goal: let edge do very fast provisional admits (probabilistic or capped) so we avoid a full RTT to central for every request. Central quota ledger remains source-of-truth; edge keeps provisional state to reduce tail latency. Thoughts?

devin: Sounds promising. Main concerns: double-counting and clients probing multiple edges to game provisonals. How do we reconcile?

amy: Reconcile plan: edge issues short-lived provisional_ids (opaque uuids) when heuristics pass, allows request immediately, and asynchronously batch-reconciles with central within ~2s. Central responds accept/reject. On reject, edge marks response as degraded and triggers refund/penalty flow.

kiran: Need per-client global outstanding-provisional limits centrally, plus per-edge caps. Otherwise abuse where client spins many edges. Maybe ephemeral client fingerprint + rate limits.

devin: Tie provisional to (client_hash + edge_id + nonce) so it's not trivially replayable across edges. Also central maintains small outstanding counter per client to bound exposure. Expire provisional ids after 2s by default.

sam: Reconcile load could spike central. We should batch and compress reconcile payloads and use backpressure/priority for safety. Example API: POST /v1/reconcile { "provisional_ids": [...], "window_ms":2000 } -> returns {accepted:[], refused:[]}

lee: On edges, add a mini token-bucket for provisional issuance to avoid being an open faucet. Also central can send a 'danger' signal (tighten heuristics) if abuse observed. Telemetry is crucial.

kiran: Rollout: prototype in staging, then opt-in Dedicated customers, then gradual ramp with metrics gating.

amy: Proposed conservation fallback: if central unreachable, edges fall back to conservative admit (e.g., 10% of normal or maintain reserve) rather than opening up. Exponential backoff for reconcile retries.

devin: Keep SDK API minimal. Sketch: func Admit(ctx, clientID, hints) -> (allowed bool, provisionalID string, reason string). Opaque IDs preferred.

sam: For abuse defenses, consider optional lightweight PoW or HMAC proof tied to client credential for high-value tenants. Also heuristics for new clients vs known good clients.

lee: Add logging tag for heuristic used (edge-prob, edge-fastpath) so central can correlate and tune thresholds. Telemetry surfaces: provisional_issue_rate, provisional_accept_rate, provisional_reject_rate, edge-degrade-ratio.

amy: Action items:
- amy: write short RFC sketch + diagrams (today)
- devin: prototype shim + admit SDK (next week)
- kiran: define telemetry & alert thresholds (SLO guardrails)
- lee: implement per-edge cooldown TB + danger-signal handler
- sam: enumerate abuse scenarios + PoW experiment plan

ops-bot: staging quota created: infra-soft-admit-stg (10k qps across 2 nodes)

kiran: One more: for reconcile mismatch (central denies after edge allowed), plan for graceful user experience: degrade responses (shorter output, simp fallback) and issue refund/metric increment. Avoid silently dropping.

amy: Good call. We'll schedule a short sync tomorrow 10am to walk prototype and safety nets. I'll add invite.

devin: +1.

sam: I'll spin up an abuse probe harness to replay client-edge mixing patterns.

lee: I'll add diagrams to the RFC draft and post link here when ready.

amy: Thanks all, closing thread for now.
